scope: Fiziko/MetaPost physical problem illustrations and conceptual diagrams

external_references.observed: The project describes a MetaPost library for black-and-white physics textbook illustrations, including variable-width lines, shaded spheres and tubes.
The page describes a snapshot of local incompressible motion with faster/slower rotation marks and inward-spiraling, axially stretching trajectories; no such solution visual is asserted here.

figures.caption: Placa cuadrada de Poisson: fuente distribuida y u=0 en los cuatro bordes.
figures.status: physical problem schematic; not a numerical solution

figures.caption: Instantanea espacial del medio de Burgers: frente de difusion, transporte no lineal y trazas exactas.
figures.status: spatial problem schematic; no time axis or solution trajectory

figures.caption: Allen--Cahn conceptual: fases -1 y +1, zona de transicion y reaccion/difusion.
figures.status: conceptual state schematic; not a solution

figures.caption: Navier--Stokes: flujo DFG alrededor de un cilindro, perfil de entrada prescrito y Re=20.
figures.status: geometry and boundary-condition schematic; no streamlines or solved flow field

figures.caption: Bimorfo PVDF: dos capas adheridas, campo electrico hacia abajo, electrodos 100/0 V, empotramiento izquierdo y aislamiento D.n=0.
figures.status: straight physical schematic; no deformation or magnification claim

figures.caption: Arquitecturas conceptuales MLP y KAN: pesos/activacion nodal frente a funciones aprendibles en aristas y suma nodal.
Varilla introductoria de difusion: extremo caliente, extremo frio y flujo q=-k dT/dx.
